title: Big Bear River Resort

services.name: Cabin Rentals
services.desc: Our dry sleeping cabins are an upgrade from primitive campsites. This trio has 1 queen bed and 1 twin bed each, sleeping up to 3 people total. The cozy cabins are conveniently located a short walk from clean restrooms and hot showers behind the main office (facing the playground). All cabins have a table and chairs and a cozy porch. These cabins share a communal fire pit and grill. Microwaves and apartment sized refrigerators in each cabin. Air-conditioned; stand up heaters. After a full day of fun on the Niangua, relax around the fire pit at Big Bear River Resort before retiring to sleep in air-conditioned comfort. services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Six Big Bear RV spots can accommodate vehicles up to 40 ft., including a deluxe “J.B.’s RV Spot” on a concrete pad and deck furnished with patio furniture. RV sites are electric only with either 30 and 50 amp or 110 amp hookups. The resort has 2 free water filling stations plus a dump site available. services.name: Primitive Campsites
services.desc: Generators are not allowed in the primitive camping area by the river. They can be used up top. We also have electric tent sites available. Pets are welcome to join guests during their stay, but please read about the fees and rules on our Pet Policy page. Most campsites are close to the Niangua and a short walk to Mama Bear’s Mini Mart, which has a shower house with hot showers and flush toilets. Breakfast is also served at Mama Bear’s on Saturday mornings during the summer
